brand.name: MotoSecure
brand.tagline: Safer Riders · Smarter Transport · Stronger Cameroon

landing.heroTitle: Command and verify every motorcycle taxi in your city, in real time.
landing.heroSubtitle: MotoSecure gives mayors, syndicates and enforcement officers one shared, trusted system to register riders, track compliance, and respond to incidents across the commune.
landing.pillarsTitle: Three surfaces, one source of truth
landing.pillarMayorDesc: A live view of every syndicate, rider and bike under your authority, with compliance alerts and incident history.
landing.pillarSyndicateDesc: Unions register their riders and motorcycles directly, with council approval built into the workflow.
landing.pillarEnforcementDesc: Officers scan a rider's badge and get an instant, trustworthy verdict on their status and vehicle.
landing.how1Desc: A union submits its riders, licenses and motorcycles for review.
landing.how2Desc: The municipality checks documents and activates each badge.
landing.how3Desc: A QR badge scan returns a live verdict: valid, expired, or flagged.
landing.footerBuilt: Built for municipal authorities across Cameroon.
